headline: Breaking News: TSMC Falls 40 Yuan to 2,365; Taiwan Stocks Drop 214.9 Points | ETtoday Finance Cloud | ETtoday News Cloud
summary: Taiwan shares closed down 214.90 points at 44,396.70 on turnover of NT$940.4 billion, after retesting the 44,000 level intraday. TSMC closed down 40 yuan at 2,365 yuan.
why: The Taiwan index tracks the island's main listed shares, and TSMC is the world's largest contract chipmaker and a major index weight.
why_moved: The report says Taiwan stocks opened lower and traded below the flat line, with TSMC weighing on the index. It notes the decline was less severe than in Japan and Korea.
